Enclosure Dimensions (in): 3.68" x 4.67" x 1.18" Power: 9-18 volt neg. center pin. Current draw: 7mA @9V, 9mA @18V. Mori (noun, Japanese origin)- A term meaning "forest." The Kanji characters translate to Mori. The Mori Drive: for years, we have been asked to build a drive based on that old vintage standby that so many love with the famous “mid hump”…we have finally landed on a set of tweaks with this type of circuit that we believe fits with the other drives in our line, and makes all of our test amps sing. Available to Greer Amps artists only for a while, what is now known as Mori Drive is inspired by vintage TS circuitry, tuned between TS and K-style frequency ranges…it’s my personal favorite set of mods for that circuit and uses a JRC4558 chip. I’ve built a ton of TS type circuits for folks over the years and this one is the one that I think is the “Greer signature” type sound and feel for that circuit. The mid hump on the Mori Drive is positioned in a sonically pleasing area, and there is more output volume available when compared to a standard TS type circuit. Clipping is also tweaked, to achieve a smoother tone that blends so very well with a pushed amp, and stacks amazingly with your other drives. We have stacked this pedal with every single drive circuit that we have built, and with many other companies’ drives, and we have yet to find a bad combination. Add this to your board with a Lightspeed and a Southland, and you will have texture, tone, and feel on tap that is unmatched. Classic, mid focused overdrive. Wide sweet spot tone control. Asymmetrical clipping for more natural drive tones. True Bypass. Uses 9-Volt battery or standard neg. center, 2.1mm power supply. Built with top quality components. 5-year warranty to the original owner. Pedals are currently built to order, and will ship within 2-2.5 weeks of your order and payment.
